title: Proteome-scale inference of transcription factor binding motifs from predicted protein-DNA structures

documented_snapshots.basis: Release 0.1 metadata; null dates were not recorded.
documented_snapshots.ZFIN: Frozen ZFIN gene-ID mapping; original download date was not recorded.

methods.specificity_selection: Top predictions by the product of ipTM and DBD-pLDDT percentile ranks.
methods.primary_selection: Largest UPGMA cluster of predicted specificities, with equal-size ties broken by the product of member confidence ranks.
methods.primary_structure_selection: Most confident member of the primary mode by the ipTM and DBD-pLDDT percentile-rank product.

reference_sequence_provenance.note: The genome assembly and Ensembl annotation release of the TF-sequence inputs were not recorded.

alphafold3.text: Abramson, J. et al. Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions with AlphaFold 3. Nature 630, 493–500 (2024).

terms.scope: AlphaFold3 structures and derivatives, including predicted motifs, confidence summaries, DNA-contact residues, and AF3-derived domain-placement flags. Reference annotations retain their providers' terms. Repository MIT licenses apply to software.

description: Predicted DNA-binding probability matrices and selected protein-DNA structures for Danio rerio transcription factors. The tf-motif-screen pipeline uses AlphaFold3 structures, NA-MPNN specificity predictions, and consensus clustering to produce primary and alternate binding modes. The dataset includes representative mappings, reference motif comparisons, confidence summaries, domain annotations, and DNA-contact residues.
